name: scenes-gathered-zine-live-flow-v1-0
title_zh: 照片到苹果实况壁纸的完整流水线，含撕纸动效
tagline_zh: 不用再手动拆步骤：照片进，静态海报和可交互撕纸动图 ZIP 出，还能自动交给本地导入器。撕痕路径按画面内容自适应。
tagline_en: No more manual stitching: photo in, static poster + adaptive paper-tear Live Photo ZIP out, with optional local.
desc_en: Run the complete Gathered Scenes workflow from a supplied photograph to a static poster, a scene-authored adaptive v0.2 flat paper-tear Apple Live Photo ZIP, and optional handoff of that ZIP to the local Live Photo Importer. Use when the user wants the full source-to-Live-Photo flow with a custom narrative tear path and broad rounded low-frequency contours; do not use for static-only posters, 3D p
why_zh: 把「场景理解」和「撕纸动效」绑在同一条流水线上：轮廓低频圆润、撕痕叙事路径由画面内容生成。
why_en: Binds scene understanding to the tear effect in one pipeline: contours stay low-frequency and rounded, the narrative tear path.
limit_zh: 只吃单张静态照片；输出到 ZIP 为止，导入 iPhone 需本机另有 Live Photo Importer 且仅限…
limit_en: Single static photo in; output ends at ZIP. iPhone import requires a separate local Live Photo Importer (macOS only). For 3D scenes, multi-image.
title_en: Full photo-to-Live-Photo pipeline with tear-path motion
